summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a share buy-back of up to US$1,000,000,000. The buy-back will run from 6 August 2026 to no later than 23 October 2026, subject to regulatory approval. HSBC entered non-discretionary agreements with BNP Paribas, which will act as principal and make trading decisions independently. Purchases will occur on UK venues and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, with repurchased shares cancelled. Maximum repurchase is 1,718,354,635 shares under the 2026 AGM authority. This is an open-market buy-back, not a tender offer; watch execution pace and any regulatory constraints.
